subjects.name: Tycho
subjects.description: American ambient / electronic musician, composer and producer Scott Hansen (born 1977, Sacramento; based in San Francisco), who records and performs as Tycho and works as the graphic designer ISO50

subjects.name: Zhang Yimou
subjects.description: Chinese film director and cinematographer of the Fifth Generation (born 1950, Xi'an) — Red Sorghum, Ju Dou, Raise the Red Lantern, To Live, Hero, House of Flying Daggers

subjects.name: Kurt Vonnegut
subjects.description: American novelist and satirist (1922–2007, Indianapolis) — Slaughterhouse-Five, Cat's Cradle, Breakfast of Champions, The Sirens of Titan
